newsitem.title: UK: Chrysalis to buy Faze Radio, plans rights.
newsitem.headline: Chrysalis to buy Faze Radio, plans rights.

text.p: British media company Chrysalis Group Plc said on Wednesday it was buying Faze FM Radio Ltd, the owner of Kiss 102 and Kiss 105 radio stations, for 17.5 million stg in cash.

Chrysalis plans to raise 20 million stg to fund the purchase via a placing and open offer of 3.8 million new ordinary shares at 525p per share on the basis of seven new ordinary shares for every 50 ordinary shares.
The placing is underwritten by BZW.
"Faze represents a terrific opportunity which places Chrysalis firmly amongst the leaders in UK radio," said Richard Huntingford, chief executive of Chrysalis Radio.
The company said the acquisition would increase its potential UK audience to 21.8 million of adults from 15 million.
Chrysalis forecast a loss before tax of not greater than 2.0 million stg for the year to August 31, 1997 and an unchanged final dividend of 2.75p per share.
